title: 1835. Find XOR Sum of All Pairs Bitwise AND

examples.explanation: The list = [1 AND 6, 1 AND 5, 2 AND 6, 2 AND 5, 3 AND 6, 3 AND 5] = [0,1,2,0,2,1]. The XOR sum = 0 XOR 1 XOR 2 XOR 0 XOR 2 XOR 1 = 0.
The list = [12 AND 4] = [4]. The XOR sum = 4.
